propositions: The _CASCADING_EDGES table's one-eligible-status-per-edge shape does not guarantee that a child never runs ahead of its parent; two residuals exist where cascading does not occur: reactivating a closed child under an open parent, and blocked→in_progress resume under an open parent.

The store enforces the invariant that no non-terminal-state ticket can be a child of a closed ticket through the enumerated cascade table's two closed-source rows combined with the unconditional open-children close guard in transition_close.py, not through a total status ordering.

The blocked→in_progress resume does not cascade because a blocked child can never sit under a closed ancestor (the close guard prevents it), only a blocked parent would be eligible on that edge (wrong to auto-resume), and the start-work gate keys on target in_progress by design (different semantic question from cascade eligibility).

Documentation (concurrency.md §I4a) must be narrowed to state only the per-edge, same-edge guarantee the cascade table provides and must explicitly document the two accepted non-cascading residuals with their reasons.
